Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Effective Rate of Interest for 2 years at 10% = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Effective Rate of Interest for 2 years at 20% = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20)/100 = 44%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference in Effective Percentage = 44% − 21% = 23%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Interest = 23% of Principal (₹200) = (23 ÷ 100) × 200 = ₹46

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹46.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Principal (P) = ₹200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time (T) = 2 years

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Initial Rate (R1) = 10% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        New Rate (R2) = 20% per annum

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Compound Interest (CI) = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Interest at 10% (CI1) = 200 × [(1 + 10/100)2 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI1 = 200 × [(1.1)2 − 1] = 200 × [1.21 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI1 = 200 × 0.21 = ₹42

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Interest at 20% (CI2) = 200 × [(1 + 20/100)2 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI2 = 200 × [(1.2)2 − 1] = 200 × [1.44 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI2 = 200 × 0.44 = ₹88

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Difference in Interest = CI2 − CI1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Difference = 88 − 42 = ₹46

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is ₹46.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Compound Interest Concept

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Compound interest is calculated on the principal amount and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Successive Percentage Formula

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For a 2-year period, the effective rate is given by Reff = x + y + (xy/100), where x and y are the rates for each year.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Difference between CI and SI

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        For 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is P(R/100)2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n1e3:T104c,\n Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        10% पर 2 वर्षों के लिए प्रभावी ब्याज दर = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        20% पर 2 वर्षों के लिए प्रभावी ब्याज दर = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20)/100 = 44%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रभावी प्रतिशत में अंतर = 44% − 21% = 23%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अतिरिक्त ब्याज = मूलधन (₹200) का 23% = (23 ÷ 100) × 200 = ₹46

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर ₹46 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मूलधन (P) = ₹200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय (T) = 2 वर्ष

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रारंभिक दर (R1) = 10% वार्षिक

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        नई दर (R2) = 20% वार्षिक

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (CI) = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 10% पर ब्याज (CI1) = 200 × [(1 + 10/100)2 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI1 = 200 × [(1.1)2 − 1] = 200 × [1.21 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI1 = 200 × 0.21 = ₹42

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 20% पर ब्याज (CI2) = 200 × [(1 + 20/100)2 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI2 = 200 × [(1.2)2 − 1] = 200 × [1.44 − 1]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ CI2 = 200 × 0.44 = ₹88

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ब्याज में अंतर = CI2 − CI1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ अंतर = 88 − 42 = ₹46

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर ₹46 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की अवधारणा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की गणना मूलधन पर और पिछली अवधियों के संचित ब्याज पर भी की जाती है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        क्रमिक प्रतिशत सूत्र

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2 वर्ष की अवधि के लिए, प्रभावी दर Reff = x + y + (xy/100) द्वारा दी जाती है, जहाँ x और y प्रत्येक वर्ष के लिए दरें हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI और SI के बीच अंतर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2 वर्षों के लिए, CI और SI के बीच का अंतर P(R/100)2 होता है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n1e4:T597,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        అసలు మొత్తం (P) = ₹200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        కాలం (t) = 2 సంవత్సరాలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీ రేటు (R1) = 10%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీ రేటు (R2) = 20%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        చక్రవడ్డీ (CI) = P (1 + R/100)t - P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        10% వడ్డీ వద్ద:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = 200 (1 + 10/100)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = 200 (1 + 0.1)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = 200 (1.1)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = 200 x 1.21 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = 242 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI1 = ₹42

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        20% వడ్డీ వద్ద:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = 200 (1 + 20/100)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = 200 (1 + 0.2)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = 200 (1.2)2 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = 200 x 1.44 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = 288 - 200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        CI2 = ₹88

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        వడ్డీలో తేడా:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        मुद्दल (P) = 200 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The US Women's National Soccer Team won the Women's FIFA Football World Cup in 2019.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • This victory marked their fourth title in the history of the Women's World Cup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The final match was held on July 7, 2019, in Lyon, France, where the US defeated the Netherlands with a score of 2-0.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Megan Rapinoe and Rose Lavelle scored the goals for the US team in the final match.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The US team was coached by Jill Ellis, who also led the team to victory in the 2015 Women's World Cup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The Women's FIFA Football World Cup is an international football competition contested by the senior women's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The first Women's World Cup tournament was held in 1991, and it has been held every four years since then.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The 2019 tournament was the eighth edition of the Women's World Cup.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The US Women's National Soccer Team is the most successful team in the history of the Women's World Cup, having won titles in 1991, 1999, 2015, and 2019.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The US team has also been known for its advocacy for gender equality and equal pay in sports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • अमेरिका महिला राष्ट्रीय सॉकर टीम ने 2019 में महिला फीफा फुटबॉल विश्व कप जीता था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • यह जीत महिला विश्व कप के इतिहास में उनका चौथा खिताब था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • फाइनल मैच 7 जुलाई, 2019 को फ्रांस के ल्यों में आयोजित किया गया था, जहाँ अमेरिका ने नीदरलैंड को 2-0 के स्कोर से हराया था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • फाइनल मैच में अमेरिकी टीम के लिए मेगन रापिनो और रोज़ लैवेल ने गोल किए थे।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • अमेरिकी टीम का कोच जिल एलिस थीं, जिन्होंने 2015 के महिला विश्व कप में भी टीम को जीत दिलाई थी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • पहला महिला विश्व कप टूर्नामेंट 1991 में आयोजित किया गया था, और तब से यह प्रत्येक चार वर्ष में आयोजित किया जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 2019 का टूर्नामेंट महिला विश्व कप का आठवां संस्करण था।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • अमेरिकी महिला राष्ट्रीय सॉकर टीम महिला विश्व कप के इतिहास की सबसे सफल टीम है, जिसने 1991, 1999, 2015 और 2019 में खिताब जीते हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • अमेरिकी टीम को खेलों में लैंगिक समानता और समान वेतन के लिए अपनी वकालत के लिए भी जाना जाता है।
